title: fix(cli): under a wall, the ownership ceremony's rewrite gate names the act that clears a position binding, not a step that reports done
body:
Fixes #23542
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Under `group` / `isolated`, the rewrite gate of `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` refuses every `converted` position binding. That is a row binding a set the position's catalog definition does not name. The gate's remedy pointed at `authored-conversion`, but under a wall that step reports `done` before it reads a binding. The gate still refuses, and nothing is deleted or guessed. Only the remedy changes. It now depends on where the position's definition lives, as the seat ruled in its review of the readings (comment 6180941823):

| The position | Remedy under a wall |
|---|---|
| No catalog declares it | Declare it, with `permissionSets` naming the bound sets, through ONE of two doors: the deployment's code (compiled into the artifact the ceremony boots), or the metadata door as the platform administrator (`PUT /api/v1/meta/position/NAME`). A cold boot refuses a name that both a package and the environment catalog hold. |
| Declared, and the metadata door reports it editable | Add the missing sets to its `permissionSets` through the metadata door. The code door is not named, because the environment already holds the name. |
| Declared, and the door reports it not editable (a package ships it and it is sealed, ADR-0131 D6; or an item lock), or the door's verdict is unreadable | The fact only, with the shipping package when the definition's provenance names one. No act is named. |
| `conflicting` | Unchanged: the fact, and no act. |

Unchanged:
- The single-posture pointer, which is true there.
- The uncomposed-security-plugin remedy (#23359's), which is still asked first.
- `authored-conversion`'s walled note.
- The `conflicting` text.

The exact FROM → TO for each sentence is in `.changeset/23542-walled-binding-remedy.md` (`@objectstack/cli`, patch).

Text on the real served boot, from the walled case:
- **Undeclared:** "… deleting them would lose a grant. Under the isolated posture no ceremony step carries binding rows (ADR-0131 D3). Declare the position zz_undeclared with permissionSets naming member_default, through one door only: the deployment's code (compiled into the artifact this ceremony boots), or the metadata door as the platform administrator (PUT /api/v1/meta/position/zz_undeclared). A cold boot refuses a position name a package declares and the environment catalog also holds. Then re-run."
- **Sealed:** "… Under the isolated posture no ceremony step carries binding rows (ADR-0131 D3). Package com.example.ownership-catalog ships the definition of zz_shipped, which is sealed (ADR-0131 D6: the metadata door reports it not editable, lock no-overlay), so no door on this database adds those sets."

## File surface (as claimed)

- `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts`:
  - `verifyReferences`' binding half: the posture branch.
  - One helper beside it, `walledBindingRemedy`.
  - The top-of-file imports and `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_MIGRATION_ID` are untouched (PR #23461's lines). For that reason the helper reads metadata-core's `isCodeArtifactBody` through a dynamic import.
- `organization-ownership-apply.test.ts` and `organization-ownership-apply.served-catalog.integration.test.ts`.
- `.changeset/23542-walled-binding-remedy.md`.
- Not touched: the single-posture text, plugin-security, core's `convertPositionBindingRows`, spec, and the released CHANGELOG entries (#23555 remains open for those).

## Mechanism readings (the dispatch's hypotheses)

- **(a) Held.** The binding half of `verifyReferences` gives one remedy whatever the posture. The walled branch sits after the uncomposed-plugin remedy and branches on `posture !== 'single'`.
- **(b) Declared vs undeclared:** `resolveName`. **Sealed:** the metadata door's own item read, `editable`. The door derives it from `packagedBaseRefusal`, which asks `isSealedManagedItem` (ADR-0131 D6). The apply already holds that read as `MetadataLockPort.verdict`, and the command wires it to `protocol.getMetaItem`. Measured on the apply command's served boot (`bootSchemaStack` with its four composition flags, at `96918d65a1`):
  - `zz_shipped`, declared in the artifact, resolves. Its definition carries `_packageId` `com.example.ownership-catalog` and `_provenance` `package`. The door read answers `editable: false` and `lock: no-overlay`. A door save of it is refused: "provided by a managed package and is sealed against in-place edits".
  - `everyone` and `org_admin` (plugin-security built-ins) read the same way: `editable: false`, `lock: no-overlay`, package `com.objectstack.plugin-security`. A save of `everyone` is refused the same way.
  - An undeclared name reads `editable: true` because it has no item, so the helper never asks the door about one.
  - **Not readable here:** whether a package is the deployment's own app or a vendor's. The install mode is not modelled, and every artifact-loaded package counts as managed (the `isSealedManagedItem` doc in protocol.ts). So the sealed text names the package and prescribes nothing, as ruled.
  - **NOT MEASURED on the served boot:** an environment-authored (editable) position. The fixture boot defers DDL over a fresh database, so a door save there fails (no `sys_metadata` table). It is pinned at the unit layer with the door's verdict stubbed.
- **(c) The walled note is unchanged.** The operator already gets a line about these rows: the rewrite gate's blocker. A note would be a second line for the same rows.
- **(d) Pins:** listed below, with the ablation.

## Tests (head `cac34a830d`, after merging origin/main `7ffc57846a`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.test.ts src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.served-catalog.integration.test.ts`: 2 files, **100 passed**.
  - New in the unit file: walled undeclared (both doors, one-door rule, the door is never asked, nothing deleted); walled declared-editable (only the missing set, metadata door only, the door asked once); walled not-editable ×3 (package-shipped, item lock, unreadable verdict: the fact, and no act); conflicting under a wall (no act); single-posture control (pointer byte-equal, the door never asked).
  - Updated: two uncomposed-block assertions that pinned the dead pointer under a wall.
  - Served test: the walled case reads the new remedy. A new walled case on the real boot, with the command's own lock read wired in: a binding the artifact's declaration already names clears the gate (the code door, end to end on the apply boot), and `zz_shipped` gets the sealed fact with no act.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 289 files, **4317 passed**. The rest of the integration tier is declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: tsc exit 0, and `check:test-typecheck` OK. `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.json` has all 3 changed `.ts` files in the program.

## Ablation (head `96918d65a1`)

- **Mutation:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the walled branch's condition with `true`, which routes every posture to the pointer. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `50c2d1148b93` → `06372902d5dd`, marker on disk 1.
- **Result:** **10 failed / 90 passed**.
  - Red: the 5 new walled cases, the 3 updated uncomposed-block walled pins, and the 2 served walled cases. Each failed on the pointer being present or the new remedy missing.
  - Green: the conflicting case (its text is unchanged by design), the single-posture control, and every other case.
- **Restore:** blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker 0.
- No `dist` is involved: both test files import the module by its relative source path.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `cac34a830d`: 65 commands. **All 65 exit 0.** `--ran`: 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- At `96918d65a1`, the first pass had `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no full build yet). Both exit 0 after `pnpm build`.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, whole repo) at `cac34a830d`: exit 0.
- Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs. None is re-run locally beyond the above.

## Acceptance notes

- **No sanctioned act for the conflicting arm or a sealed package definition.** As the review ruled, these keep the fact and no act. Carrier: none (承接者:无) until a real deployment is measured.
- **Sealed covers the deployment's own app too.** On the served boot, the deployment's own artifact-declared position reads sealed exactly like a vendor's (`editable: false`, `lock: no-overlay`). The door's own refusal text says "Edit the source artifact and redeploy". The gate names the shipping package, so an operator can recognise their own app. It names no act, as ruled. Not filed.
- **Door A2 needs a served v18 runtime.** #15211's planned boot refusal would make it unreachable mid-ceremony. The seat posts that pointer on #15211. Noted, not filed here.
- **Single posture, observed in the control fixture.** On a resumed run where `authored-conversion` is checkpointed, a binding that arrived since gets "resolve its blocker, then re-run", but the checkpointed step does not run again. No v18 producer writes binding rows, because no runtime declares the object, so nothing reaches this. Noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
- **The served fixture grew beyond the one walled case.** It now uses the command's real lock read and declares two positions in the artifact. That stays inside the claimed test file.

## Patch round 1 (head `47cec88f79`; the seat's review, comment 6182144654)

- **Item 1.** The undeclared remedy no longer says "in the environment catalog". Here the environment catalog means the environment-authored items, and a code declaration is a package declaration, so the old sentence contradicted the code door. The sentence now reads "Declare the position NAME with permissionSets naming SETS, through one door only: …". The same edit is made in the changeset's TO line and in the table and quote above.
- **Item 2.** In the uncomposed-block walled control, `everyone` now pins only that the pointer is gone, beside the existing check that the composition is gone. It no longer pins `PUT /api/v1/meta/position/everyone`. That act came from the undeclared branch: the unit fake catalog declares no `everyone`, so the door's verdict is never asked. A composed boot declares `everyone`, sealed.
- **Re-run at `47cec88f79`:**
  - Both test files: 2 files, 100 passed.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
  - `dispatch-gates --commands`: the same 65 families, run under the lock after a full build. All 65 exit 0. `--ran`: 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **Not merged with origin/main:** `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` (`cdc42eb495`) is clean.
